description: Browse the VSP 360 REST API. With no arguments, lists the API areas (tags) and how many operations each has. With `tag` and/or `query`, lists matching operations (operationId, method, path, summary). Use this first to find the operationId you need, then vsp360_describe_operation and vsp360_call_operation. Operations marked [write] are blocked because the server runs read-only.

query.description: What you want to do, in plain words (e.g. 'volumes with no host path', 'replication pairs status'). Ranked by BM25 relevance with a confidence rating.

tag.description: API area, e.g. 'Device Registry', 'Platform Alerts', 'Users'. Case-insensitive.

name: vsp360_list_operations
